text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: By the night as it covers.
text_1989: By the night as it falls.
text_ref: By the night as it falls.

text_1981: Your Lord did not foresake you, nor does He hate you.
text_1989: Your Lord never abandoned you, or did He forget.
text_ref: Your Lord never abandoned you, nor did He forget.

text_1981: The hereafter is what really counts, not this life.
text_1989: The Hereafter is far better for you than this first (life).
text_ref: The Hereafter is far better for you than this first (life).

text_1981: Your Lord will bless you, until you are pleased. 6.
text_1989: And your Lord will give you enough; you will be pleased.
text_ref: And your Lord will give you enough; you will be pleased.

text_1981: Did He not find you orphaned and He gave you a home?
text_1989: Did He not find you orphaned and He gave you a home?
text_ref: Did He not find you orphaned and He gave you a home?

text_1981: He found you astray, and guided you.
text_1989: He found you astray, and guided you.
text_ref: He found you astray, and guided you.

text_1981: Did He not find you poor, and He made you rich?
text_1989: He found you poor, and made you rich.
text_ref: He found you poor, and made you rich.

text_1981: Therefore, you shall not mistreat the orphan.
text_1989: Therefore, you shall not forsake the orphan.
text_ref: Therefore, you shall not forsake the orphan.

text_1981: Nor shall you despise the poor.
text_1989: Nor shall you reprimand the beggar.
text_ref: Nor shall you reprimand the beggar.

text_1981: And speak up of your Lord’s blessings.
text_1989: You shall proclaim the blessing your Lord has bestowed upon you.
text_ref: You shall proclaim the blessing your Lord has bestowed upon you.
